ModMetaData.name: Trader Hotline – Call the Trader You Want
ModMetaData.author: Bolek98
ModMetaData.description:
Call the trader you want from the comms console – and it really comes.
- Pick any orbital trade ship or a caravan of any friendly faction (also from mods) in a clear window with categories (weapons, medicine, food, tech …), favorites and search. - See everything a trader sells and what it would buy from your stores. - Special orders: the trader brings extra goods of the kind you need. - Normal or express delivery; pay from any silver in your stores – no orbital beacons needed. - Countdown in the alerts. - If it can't come (game limits, other mods), it tries again for two days – otherwise your fee comes back. - A called trade ship stays longer; caravans are cheaper. - The called ship is put in orbit directly, so other trader mods can't swallow it.
Safe to add to an existing save. Requires Harmony. English and Czech.
